title: Transport-independent owner writes on a provider
description: The document ummanu.webproto's provider operation returns: one Codex rate-limit reset press under the request id the caller names, read off the board audit record that every answer is. `replayed` is true when a committed record for the id answered and nothing was sent. No token reaches it, and no failure is a status number.

credits.description: The reset credits the live usage read saw before the press.

outcome.description: As the record holds it: the provider's answer (`reset`, `nothing_to_reset`, `no_credit`, `already_redeemed`, or `error` with its `reason`), `refused` when no credit was available and nothing was sent, or `unknown` for a press staged and never settled.
